section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion reports that Zimbabwean women who migrated to Britain exhibited more negative body image and greater weight discrepancy than women in Zimbabwe, despite no significant difference in self-reported BMI. The BAS (body appreciation scale) was used and showed a dominant general body appreciation factor; exposure to Western media was associated with greater weight discrepancy and lower body appreciation. The authors note limitations including nonrepresentative samples of women and lack of measures of social status.
